evidence.reason: The default root is derived at line 448 with `rev-parse --absolute-git-dir`. For a linked worktree that command prints `<main>/.git/worktrees/<id>`, so the default worktreeRoot differs per checkout: from the main checkout it is `<main>/.git/cq-review-worktrees`, from a linked worktree it is `<main>/.git/worktrees/<id>/cq-review-worktrees`. The module doc supplied at lines 423-427 states that only an OWN (in-worktreeRoot) tree is reused and branch+sha-valid trees outside it surface as `foreign`, so a tree created from the main checkout is classified foreign when resolving from a linked worktree and is never reused; `git worktree add -B` then fails because the existing tree still holds the `cq-review/pr-<n>` branch label. Additionally, nesting checkouts inside `.git/worktrees/<id>` means `git worktree remove <linked>`/`prune` can delete them along with unpushed work. The comment at lines 444-447 only justifies the git dir because a linked worktree/submodule has a `.git` FILE (ENOTDIR); it does not make per-checkout placement or nesting under the ephemeral admin dir intended. Using `--path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` yields the stable shared `<main>/.git` root for all worktrees of the repo (and leaves submodule behavior unchanged), which is the correct fix; the same command is still present at the tip, so this is not fixed. The secondary occurrence near line 708 was not in the supplied region, but the primary defect at line 448 stands on the supplied code.
